restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 2423f959, fe640e8c. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 46 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_46(M(x))) XOR q with published q=c5ab6baef5ba095e60d596fbefcc417209984881037230916e4a57eb6128cc19. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=3400. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181911986872385 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 46.94992.
Peak memory is 1048571 bytes; setup peaks at 659464 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 5ecb4b80a26e7b908908e627bd0d666e2339cf3a9b474be8125bbe97e7544bba; stripped wasm SHA-256 580c4bb45b5d06037af53c630e46d708496108b0ffab656335398e4e5bea56f9; emitted SLP SHA-256 6faecd7efae2f9a9fbd155fe41c390f6ff8c137ee2c950ea9e96bb2a68f8d876. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r46-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections, and compare fixed width-20 and width-22 projections with shared-function random-mapping ensembles. The fourfold state-space change checks persistence only. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
